title: Values and Variables: Giving Data a Name

ai_pair_moment.flaw: The AI wrote score_1 + score_2 + score_3 / 3 and predicted 90.0. Python divides before it adds, so the program prints 203.33333333333334. Brackets around the sum fix it.

changes: Added round() as a small extra beyond the curriculum entry, because the chapter shows that float results can be inexact and learners need a way to display them.
Used 0.1 + 0.1 + 0.1 (the official tutorial's example) instead of the commonly quoted 0.1 + 0.2.
Changed the cafe bill prices so the final amount is exact and does not need rounding of a half.

2026-11-09 revision (owner request): added the narrated full-chapter video (video/storyboard.json rendered to video/chapter.mp4 with captions) and re-verified on Python 3.15.2, the current release, after fixing the setup tool's stale uv.
outstanding_issues: The traceback for Mistake 1 shows the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path to the file appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Piper, en_US-lessac-medium). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the renderer's PRONOUNCE list.
